einzeiler: Investigative reporter Michelle McPhee unpacks a billion-dollar biofuel fraud scheme.
kurzfassung: Investigative journalist Michelle McPhee joins the podcast to discuss her reporting on a massive biofuel fraud scheme orchestrated by a fundamentalist Mormon polygamist and an Armenian businessman. The scheme exploited government green energy incentives, looting over half a billion dollars from the US treasury. McPhee details the complex web of corruption, extravagant spending, and the brave whistleblowers who helped bring the criminals down.
stichpunkte: Investigative reporter Michelle McPhee discusses her podcast Kingdom of Fraud.
Jacob Kingston, a member of the polygamist Kingston Clan in Utah, teamed up with Armenian tycoon Levon Termendzhyan.
The pair orchestrated a massive biofuel fraud, stealing over 500 million dollars in US government tax credits.
The Kingston Clan operates under the edict of bleeding the beast, viewing government theft as payback.
Jacob Kingston sought to gain status and pay off his father's debts through the fraudulent scheme.
Levon Termendzhyan lived a lavish lifestyle, driving a chrome Lamborghini and surrounding himself with high-level corrupt officials.
Whistleblowers from within the Kingston Clan, including a survivor named Priscilla, went to the FBI to expose the operation.
Despite being tipped off about an impending raid, investigators recovered a critical hard drive that secured convictions.

beschreibung:
This week, Meagan and Lola sit down with Michelle McPhee, investigative reporter and host of podcast Kingdom of Fraud, to discuss how Jacob Kingston, a fundamentalist Mormon from the secretive polygamist sect known as the Kingston clan, or the “Order,” teamed up with a shadowy Armenian tycoon nicknamed “the Lion” to commit one of the largest fraud schemes in U.S. history.
She’ll explain how Jacob’s drive to prove himself as one of over 100 siblings within the insular Kingston hierarchy got him in over his head with Levon Termendzhyan, his unlikely partner in the massive scheme they embarked on: it involved renewable fuel tax credits, international money laundering, powerful political connections, and billions of dollars. Plus, how they finally got caught–with the help of a couple of Trust Me’s previous guests.
